key_idea: Constructing one subgraph that forces a monochromatic triple and another that forbids it, combining them into a massive graph whose non-colorability is verified by computer search.
reason: The proof relies on constructing massive graphs and delegates the heavy lifting to SAT solvers and custom backtracking programs. While the high-level architecture of forcing and forbidding patterns is logical, the core of the proof is a machine-generated certificate that offers no human-graspable reason for the result.
recognized: Aubrey de Grey (2018), The chromatic number of the plane is at least 5
